verdict.rationale: Vercel Workflows runs multi-step logic as durable background code that retries failed steps, waits for external events, and resumes across crashes and deployments. The eve framework (beta) builds durable backend AI agents on Vercel with Agent Runs observability. Git-push deploys and webhooks provide event triggers, so the core of the story is delivered, though only as developer-coded primitives. Missing for 10: documented scheduled/cron triggers beyond on-schedule page regeneration, a no-code way to set up automations, eve being out of beta, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
